report.explanation: All 12 checkout observations returned 200 with durations 47-297ms; traces show successful spans across order, inventory, payment, and postgres. Metrics show /v1/checkout p95 ~412ms but zero 502s. No errors, no deployment facts, and no memory-retention series. Current evidence does not establish any bounded root cause; the operator hypothesis of a fault is contradicted by healthy telemetry, so hand off for more evidence.
missing_evidence: Per-dependency latency/error metrics for gateway->order and order->inventory/payment/postgresql to localize the slow span
Logs for gateway/order (excluded evidence ev-4d2ee14f4db62fe6-r0-gw-logs) to identify errors or timeouts
Baseline latency distribution for /v1/checkout to judge whether 412ms p95 is anomalous
Evidence of resource saturation (CPU, connection pool, GC) on order or downstream services
